reply_text:
I replied to Dana in their DM. Moss's notes have two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). The gatehouse kiosk at the Eau Claire yard wasn't sending SMS bay assignments to drivers. Support patched it on 4 Oct 2025.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (undated). Barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it went to tier-2 support.

I also told Dana that two more Moss notes mention Quarrendon but carry no ticket numbers. Tickets #4409 and #4412 in Moss's Central handoffs note belong to another account, so I left them out.

I flagged one problem for Dana to check before it goes in the weekly notes. A note by Marcus (not Moss) also gives #4419 for Quarrendon, but describes it as a printer delay at Gate 3, not the scanner problem.

Moss's notes are public files, so Dana can see them. I only read the knowledge brain, which holds public files and channel history, and didn't read any channels. Nothing in the reply is a finance figure, and no approval was needed.
